architecture: Small neural inverse-kinematics map from arm identity and requested Cartesian gripper point to five joint targets. Joint feedback limits command rate and guards progress. Current RGB bottle points define approach/descent goals. Explicit semantic phases and a separate privileged physical stop/score monitor remain disclosed.
training_source: Offline ArmIK solutions with local-Y-up orientation. These kinematic labels are not physical demonstrations and do not establish contact success. The 15 verified physical motions remain available for observer supervision and controller diagnostics.
network: Four inputs, three 256-unit SiLU layers, five outputs; normalized Cartesian coordinates and joint targets.
acceptance: Retain every failed teacher solution. Score neural predictions with independent robot forward kinematics. Deployment refuses predictions beyond joint limits or above 1.5 mm position / 0.025 axis residual; no inference-time IK fallback. Full physical trials and live/frozen image comparisons are required separately.
